title: Switching failure indicator at zero threshold
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and fix signs on the coordinates outside $J$. The indicator that the decision-tree depth of the restriction of $f$ to those fixed signs is at least zero equals one.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
